When I was a sophomore, I came out as a bisexual. An upperclassman came up to me, yelled “hey bisexual girl!” and took me to a GSA which was called HOME (can’t remember what it stood for) and that’s when I had my first interactions with openly gay humans that were my age.

That same year, I think, I had my first “girlfriend” that I met on MySpace lol she was beautiful, kind, funny, and loving. We would talk on the phone for hours and hours on end. She gave me my first heartbreak.
That same night, she added me on myspace, got my number, and two weeks later I asked her to be my girlfriend.

She was my first everything. She met my friends, my family, my youth group. We went on little daycations/vacations together. When she dumped me later that year she gave me the courage and strength to come out as a lesbian in October of 2007. And I never looked back.
